caption: The drawing depicts a single, translucent glass vessel positioned centrally within a rectangular border on a cream-colored background. The glass is light blue-green in color, with a wide, flared rim tapering down to a narrower base that sits atop a thick, scalloped foot with ridged detailing. There are slight variations in tone within the glass, suggesting transparency and reflections on the surface. The illustration is detailed, showing subtle imperfections and bubbles within the glass. The artist's signature, "JANET RIZA," is present in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Toddy Glass
